relay.title: Relay Diffusion
relay.budget: ImageNet: 1250M training images across the cascade; per-stage allocation not identified
relay.evaluation: ImageNet FID 1.87; exact low/high checkpoint pair required
gaps: Per-stage best-run image budget not identified; image-count EMA and loss scaling must be retained.

ssd.title: Scale Space Diffusion
ssd.evaluation: 2/4 levels at64,3/5 at128,3/6 at256; source DDPM sampler
gaps: Batch64 is train_ssd.sh:32 per rank times2; best paper row is not uniquely selected.
Do not use lr_anneal_steps as a stop cap: it changes the LR schedule.

pixelflow.title: PixelFlow
pixelflow.evaluation: FID1.98: Dopri5, atol1e-6, rtol.001 in code, four-stage CFG max2.4
gaps: Public YAML is 10 epochs and batch4 per rank, not an identified best training run.
Published best training global batch/budget not identified in the inspected paper/release.

dfm.title: Improving Progressive Generation with Decomposable Flow Matching
dfm.initialization: Paper DiT-XL + scale-equivariant FLUX VAE; public release SiT + SD VAE
gaps: Public SiT release explicitly differs from the paper architecture and VAE.
SE autoencoder/private fine-tuning data and original full best-run recipe are unavailable.

lapflow.title: LapFlow
lapflow.evaluation: ImageNet XL T=.5, EMA.9999; exact best CFG not identified
gaps: CLI defaults T=.9/LR5e-4/EMA.9 differ from AppendixG.
HQ uses cosine2e-4 to1e-6, batches256/256/128,3scales at512/1024.
Released square sampler bug and exact best CFG remain unresolved.

ppflow.title: Pyramidal Patchification Flow for Visual Generation
ppflow.budget: XL256 pretrained:1M updates; XL512:400k; B scratch:11M; FLUX:90k
ppflow.initialization: XL256 starts from SiT-XL/2; SD VAE
ppflow.evaluation: XL2 FID1.99, CFG[1,3]; XL3 FID2.23, CFG[1,3.5,3.75]; source Heun2
gaps: Public CLI defaults1400epochs and lacks an exact max-update/accumulation flag.
FLUX text-to-image and some paper variants are not released.
The SiT initialization includes substantial prior training cost.

dctdiff.title: DCTdiff
dctdiff.evaluation: Native DPM/EM and exact DCT codec, resize and EBFR
gaps: Paper DiT branches are not released.
A different dataset requires re-estimated DCT statistics, not copying CIFAR constants.

mdm.title: Matryoshka Diffusion Models
mdm.dataset: Released weights:50M Flickr text-image pairs; configs:CC12M
mdm.budget: Public CC12M config:1M updates; warmup10k; full Flickr curriculum unidentified
mdm.evaluation: Nested256/1024;250 resampled steps, CFG7.5, clipping in demo
gaps: Flickr training data/curriculum are not reproduced by CC12M configs.
Published best global batch not established; commented batch fields are not authoritative.
Online T5/streaming/DDP curriculum parity is unverified.

dimr.title: DiMR: Multi-Resolution Diffusion Models
dimr.budget: Best released256 weights:800epochs; Python config:1M updates; warmup5k
dimr.initialization: scratch DiMR-G/2R orXL/2R; original SD VAE moments
dimr.evaluation: G/2R FID1.63; XL/2R1.70;250steps, native guidance scale.4,power-1
gaps: 800epochs and1M updates are different budgets; do not label the latter best-run reproduction.
Source fp16/accelerate16rank lifecycle and real VAE pipeline are not GPU-certified here.

diffusability.title: Improving the Diffusability of Autoencoders
diffusability.initialization: pretrained codec, SE2/4 fine-tuning, downstream generator retraining
diffusability.evaluation: Codec SE/VGG loss plus separately retrained generator quality
gaps: Release README still lists training/evaluation instructions and checkpoints as TODO.
Codec component checks cannot reproduce the full generator-quality main table.

rmd.title: Cross-Resolution Distribution Matching for Diffusion Distillation
rmd.budget: Release14B:max300,warmup15; best paper budget not established
rmd.evaluation: Native6-step rollout, CFG5, eta.5, flowshift3; optional GAN separate
gaps: Public14B effective batch=4x8x2=64, not paper video batch4.
Local full14B/GAN/main-table recipe not certified; source author attribution remains unconfirmed.

speed.title: Spectral Progressive Diffusion for Efficient Image and Video Generation
speed.evaluation: Spectral transform/DCT-Haar-FFT, scale schedule and NFE must match each row
gaps: Not a training baseline; needs exact pretrained weights, prompts, metric assets and selected main-table row.

nami.title: NAMI
nami.initialization: trained NAMI transformer and learned bridge, vendor Diffusers
nami.evaluation: Progressive depth/resolution and trained bridge; distinct from plain FLUX
gaps: Published training recipe cannot be recovered from an inference-only release.

mrflow.title: Multi-Resolution Flow Matching
mrflow.evaluation: Low-res flow, PIL/VAE/SR transition, high-res refinement; exact NFE/model required
gaps: Not a scratch-training baseline; evaluate exact full pretrained pipeline and transitions.

rdd.title: RDD (migrated local code)
rdd.budget: Historical L reached492000; XL407600; scripts epoch ceiling1400
rdd.initialization: scratch DiT-L/2 orXL/2; SD VAE ema;32/16/8 latent grids
rdd.evaluation: 300/300/400 stages; EMA.9999; retained source native staged sampler
gaps: 400k is a newly chosen common budget, not the exact last step of both historical runs.
Historical image datasets/weights are not all migrated; do not resume deleted GPU-check payloads.

policies.gpu_policy: Previous authorization expired; CPU only until explicit renewal with deadline.
limitations: Single-process matched-core runner; multi-rank author lifecycle is not certified.
Fair-rdd preserves each architecture/codec/initialization/target/path/sampler; not a common-backbone ablation.
Equal updates/global batch imply equal images, NOT equal FLOPs or pretrained cost.
Small FP32 synthetic checks cannot guarantee full-training FID, BF16/CUDA/DDP equivalence.
